Browave.why: Browave sells fiber harnesses / FAUs and jumpers for 800G/1.6T AI data-center transceivers and fiber shuffle boxes for CPO platforms; optical-interconnect buildout drives its revenue.
Browave.evidence: Browave 2026 investor conference deck (03-10-2026): OIN (33% of 2025 revenue) supplies custom 800G/1.6T jumpers for AI servers and new fiber shuffle boxes for CPO platforms; CPO fiber harness and shuffle box products expected to enter mass production in 2H 2026.

players.product: Passive optical components: fiber harnesses / fiber array units (FAU) for 800G/1.6T pluggable transceivers (FR and DR), 800G/1.6T and MMC jumpers, and CPO fiber shuffle boxes and high-channel-count FAUs; WDM and branch (splitter) modules for PON/FTTH and CATV

quarterly_data.signal: Browave 2025 (ROC year 114) results: operating revenue NT$2,226 million, gross profit NT$402 million (gross margin 18%), operating income NT$120 million, pre-tax income NT$536 million, net income NT$501 million, EPS NT$6.22.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue NT$2,226 million; GM 18%; net income NT$501 million; EPS NT$6.22

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue mix by product: WDM 27%, Branch 28%, OIN 33%, AMP 12%; by shipment region: Americas 31%, Europe 13%, Asia 56%. WDM focuses on AI/data-center fiber harness products (FR platform) and CATV broadband; Branch on next-generation PON/FTTH (1x32, 1x64) and AI/data-center fiber harnesses (DR platform); OIN on custom 800G/1.6T jumpers for AI servers plus new fiber shuffle boxes for CPO high-density fiber layouts; AMP on telecom.
quarterly_data.figure: WDM 27%, Branch 28%, OIN 33%, AMP 12%; Americas 31%, Europe 13%, Asia 56%

quarterly_data.signal: Browave's AI/data-center business: fiber harness (FAU) products for 800G and above AI/DC server transceivers, ramping mainly on the FR and DR platforms and focused on the North American market; jumpers ramping mainly on single-mode with some multimode; a new MMC jumper line for ultra-small rack space and high-density connections. 1.6T FAU (DR and FR types) and ELSFP FAU (PMF) for pluggable transceivers are in its line-up.

For CPO, Browave offers fiber shuffle boxes with termination (DR or FR; 1,152~4,096 single-mode fibers; SN-MT, MMC, MXC, SN, MDC; blind-mate connector), PM-type FAU/termination in ELSFP/QSFP-DD (8~12 ports PMF), optical-engine (CPO) FAU (40-80 ports SMF, pitch 127um) and high-channel-count FAUs (20, 40, 60, 72 channels). The deck shows these against a photo of the Nvidia Quantum-X Photonics switch (2025 GTC); it does not state a customer.

Browave expects its CPO products - fiber harnesses and fiber shuffle boxes - to start mass production in the second half of 2026 (ROC year 115). 2026 focus: AI server shuffle modules, 800G/1.6T fiber harnesses, 800G/1.6T jumpers and MMC jumpers, branch products for next-generation PON/FTTH, and WDM products for next-generation CATV.

Management on telecom: end-customer inventory is gradually being digested and North American telecom subsidy programs are becoming clearer; demand for next-generation PON/FTTH WDM and high-channel branch (1x32, 1x64) products for city deployment is strong.
